visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Merge Sort Instead of Bubble Sort
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Nested loops compare neighbours repeatedly, taking about n squared steps. Sort with merge sort instead. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Merge sort halves the problem log2(n) times and does about n work per level, so it needs about n log n steps. Bubble sort needs n squared, which is tens of thousands of times slower for a million elements.
